title: LEGO® MARVEL Super Heroes
notes: Played full first level at 60 fps using DXVK. Gameplay is smooth and fully playable with an Xbox controller, but in-engine cutscenes render with missing floor/background textures. Requires launch argument -novid to skip intro video crashes. DLL overrides d3d9=n,b;d3d11=n,b and Emulate display mode enabled for proper screen scaling.
issues: Game froze during intro cutscenes without -novid; minor audio stuttering fixed with V-Sync.
